verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a first-party Approvals feature: members making a flag change can request approval from a member or team, so planned changes get review before they apply. The evidence only describes requesting approval as an option, though. Nothing shows approvals can be made mandatory, scoped to production environments, or that unapproved changes are blocked. Missing for 10: documented enforcement of required approvals for production environments, change-request workflow details (reviewer counts, apply-after-approval gating), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: they have the option to request approval for that change from a member or team in their LaunchDarkly project.
Approvals let more people have input on planned changes.
